name: Default starter rule set (Israel)
description: Starter design rules shipped with the plugin (D3). Copy this file and edit values for an office or municipality. Values marked verified=false still need checking against the published standard before relying on them.

rules.label: Accessible route: maximum slope along the path
rules.source: SI 1918 part 1 (accessible route; steeper than this is a ramp)

rules.label: Paved plaza: minimum drainage fall
rules.source: Generic good practice for unit paving drainage (editable)

rules.label: Paved plaza: maximum fall (plaza is part of the accessible route)
rules.source: SI 1918 part 1 (level areas on the accessible route)

rules.label: Lawn: minimum fall so it drains
Planting bed: maximum slope before it needs erosion control (1:3)
